suites.description: Phase 00 focused contract and baseline characterization tests; not live gameplay acceptance
suites.notAcceptanceReason: Runs the NPC autonomy harness, not the real gameplay scene.

suites.description: Phase 02 shared character motor and CharacterBody3D NPC migration tests; not live gameplay acceptance
suites.notAcceptanceReason: Validates motor contracts in the focused harness.

suites.description: Phase 03 multi-surface navigation world and invalidation tests; not live gameplay acceptance
suites.notAcceptanceReason: Validates topology contracts in the focused harness.

suites.description: Phase 04 hierarchical route planner, semantic costs, and corridor service tests; not live gameplay acceptance
suites.notAcceptanceReason: Uses synthetic route fixtures and cannot prove an NPC walked a real generated-world route.

suites.description: Phase 05 incremental route repair and dynamic response service tests; not live gameplay acceptance
suites.notAcceptanceReason: Uses controlled repair fixtures and cannot prove live NPC recovery.

suites.description: Phase 06 smart door portal, controller, authority, and safety service tests; not live gameplay acceptance
suites.notAcceptanceReason: Exercises door services directly and cannot prove a live NPC opened and crossed a generated-world door.

suites.description: Phase 07 predictive local avoidance and stable corridor follower tests; not live gameplay acceptance
suites.notAcceptanceReason: Uses focused avoidance scenarios outside the full gameplay loop.

suites.description: Phase 08 traffic reservation, door queue fairness, and deadlock recovery service tests; not live gameplay acceptance
suites.notAcceptanceReason: Uses controlled reservation fixtures and cannot prove live crowd behavior.

suites.description: Phase 09 utility goals, symbolic task planning, and schedule service tests; not live gameplay acceptance
suites.notAcceptanceReason: Validates behavior services and schedules without proving live scripted NPC execution.

suites.description: Phase 10 smart-object interaction, job, and guard service tests; not live gameplay acceptance
suites.notAcceptanceReason: Uses focused smart-object scenarios outside full generated-world gameplay.

suites.description: Phase 11 streaming, abstract simulation, save migration, and lifecycle service tests; not live gameplay acceptance
suites.notAcceptanceReason: Validates persistence and lifecycle contracts without proving live path traversal.

suites.description: Phase 12 deterministic fuzz, soak, performance, and recovery hardening tests; not live gameplay acceptance
suites.notAcceptanceReason: Uses deterministic synthetic stress scenarios and cannot prove visible gameplay acceptance.
